CHIEF READ-ONLY CHECK OF 1363fd4684c51dba71089c97eda6bdd34e1420d8: no blocker found within the assigned successor scope. Exact archive bash -n passed and tools/reference-scope-test.sh passed 70 assertions. The declaration recognizer accepts repeated qualified-private, abstract, open, final, sealed, and case modifiers in flexible order. Shared and JVM roots are scanned; a changed JS or Native path and an unchanged JS or Native consumer both refuse with exit 4 and exact module/path before any partial JVM command. Deleted declarations are read from BASE.

One pre-existing false-success remains outside this successor: a recognized module source containing only top-level def, val, or given returns exit 0 with no gate. It does not affect the Stage 1b class-based repair and I am not moving the current goalpost. Follow-up bead bd-01M1CGP2K4H93WM8CW5EFEPTJK records the fail-closed repair and is blocked on this bead. Named reviewers still owe independent verdicts; this note is not landing authorization.
